# IOriginUSD
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/origin/IOriginUSD.sol)

**Title:**
IOriginUSD

Minimal interface for the Origin rebasing USD token (OUSD)


## Functions
### mint

Mints tokens to an account (vault only)


```solidity
function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`to`|`address`|The recipient of the minted tokens|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount to mint|
